description: **`pc_deploy uninstall` still goes ahead with a stopped watcher and a pending restore**: `wait_for_restore` in `proxy/tools/pc_deploy.py` returns on an unusable watcher before reading `_active.json`, so a stale heartbeat prints "cannot be seen" with the file there to read, and the next watcher start restores the mod ini: a stray again. Decide whether to refuse there and what the way out is when the watcher will not start; W94 decision 4 only reasoned about a host with no watcher. Also in this area: refuse at once when the caller holds the lock (the restore waits for that lock, so the 30 s wait cannot help); `tests.test_pc_deploy` needs bash, but only `harness-windows` sets `WSC_REQUIRE_BASH` and it does not run that module, so a lost bash is only a warning on `gates (windows-latest)`; napoleon `play.py` `profile_active` reads an unreadable `_active.json` as none where the core says pending, which leaves the packs out and the proxy in (the game's to change). From W94 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: `pc_deploy uninstall` with a stopped watcher and a pending restore
